note: Registered official/primary sources from the project source registry (V6 spec). External fetching follows the SSRF/allowlist policy.

sources.title: NASA Space Apps 2026 — Flame in Freefall
sources.use: Challenge requirements, requested output and three fire-safety pillars. Re-open current official challenge content and verify exact wording.

sources.title: NASA Physical Sciences Informatics
sources.use: Primary investigation records and datasets. Prefer official repository metadata and download pathways.

sources.title: NASA PSI Database Guide
sources.use: How PSI is organized and accessed.

sources.title: NASA Technical Reports Server
sources.use: Technical reports, publications, metadata and downloadable documents.

sources.title: NASA NTRS OpenAPI
sources.use: Documented citation search, pubspace search, document/download endpoints and exports; inspect live schema before coding.

sources.title: NASA Glenn Combustion Science
sources.use: Current and historical combustion investigations, science descriptions and research programme context.

sources.title: NASA Fluids and Combustion Facility
sources.use: Facility structure and experiment equipment context. Verify which hardware was used by each investigation.

sources.title: NASA FM² — Flammability of Materials on the Moon
sources.use: Partial-gravity lunar material flammability research context; distinguish planned/future work from completed data.

sources.title: NASA SoFIE — Solid Fuel Ignition and Extinction
sources.use: Experimental scope, objectives and relevant future/available data status.

sources.title: NASA FLARE — Flammability Limits at Reduced g
sources.use: Reduced-g flammability investigation context; carefully distinguish data availability and flight status.

sources.title: NASA Images and Video API documentation
sources.use: Search, asset, metadata, captions and album endpoints; retrieve official media with captions and IDs.

sources.title: NASA Images API
sources.use: Official media discovery and metadata. Verify licensing/credit and asset URL before storing.

sources.title: NASA 3D Resources
sources.use: Official spacecraft/planet/hardware 3D assets. Check asset-specific rights, formats and model metadata.

sources.title: NASA ISS 3D Model
sources.use: Official ISS model reference; preserve actual provenance and model fidelity.

sources.title: NASA OSDR API
sources.use: OSDR REST API for study/data files and metadata; OSDR primarily serves space biology/biomedical and related data, not a dedicated combustion repository. Use only for supplementary mission/crew/bio context where relevant.

sources.title: NASA OSDR API description
sources.use: Official overview of OSDR API and data access. Do not conflate OSDR with PSI combustion data.

sources.title: Cantera documentation
sources.use: Thermodynamics, kinetics, transport and selected 0-D/1-D reacting systems; verify mechanism and boundary condition suitability.

sources.title: Cantera One-dimensional Flames
sources.use: Premixed, burner-stabilized, counterflow diffusion and strained flames; not a general spacecraft microgravity simulator.

sources.title: OpenFOAM solver documentation
sources.use: Reacting-flow solvers including fireFoam/reactingFoam; use only after solver physics, boundary conditions and validation are established.

sources.title: NIST FDS and Smokeview manuals
sources.use: FDS user, technical reference, verification and validation manuals; terrestrial fire modelling is not automatically valid for microgravity.

sources.title: NIST CFAST
sources.use: Compartment fire model for applicable building/compartment scenarios; do not assume validation for spacecraft or reduced gravity.

sources.title: DeepXDE
sources.use: PINN/scientific machine-learning framework. Requires well-defined PDEs, boundary conditions, adequate data and validation.

sources.title: NVIDIA PhysicsNeMo
sources.use: Physics-informed ML, neural operators, GNNs, transformers and surrogate models for scientific computing; typically expects field/simulation data and compute.

sources.title: DeepFlame documentation
sources.use: Deep-learning-assisted combustion CFD/solver integration candidate; verify current maintenance, license, solver compatibility and benchmark evidence before adoption.

sources.title: Meta Segment Anything Model 2
sources.use: Promptable image/video segmentation and tracking; not a trained flame detector. Fine-tune/evaluate on annotated flame imagery.

sources.title: OpenCV documentation
sources.use: Image/video preprocessing, calibration, optical flow, tracking and classical CV.

sources.title: CVAT annotation platform
sources.use: Human annotation and QA for flame masks, bounding boxes, video sequences and instrument regions.

sources.title: Docling supported formats and extraction
sources.use: PDF, Office, spreadsheets, images, video and structured extraction; page/figure/table provenance must still be audited.

sources.title: GROBID full text processing
sources.use: Scientific article structure, TEI, bibliographic metadata and citation extraction.

sources.title: Qdrant hybrid search
sources.use: Combine dense semantic and sparse/BM25 retrieval with rank fusion; benchmark against BM25 baseline and held-out queries.

sources.title: pgvector
sources.use: PostgreSQL vector similarity extension; simpler deployment if PostgreSQL is adopted, but measure hybrid retrieval needs.

sources.title: SHAP
sources.use: Feature attribution explanations; do not treat attribution as causal effect.

sources.title: SALib
sources.use: Sobol, Morris, FAST and other global sensitivity methods with defined model inputs/ranges.

sources.title: MLflow Model Registry
sources.use: Experiment lineage, model versioning, aliases, tags, staging/production management.

sources.title: Three.js
sources.use: Core WebGL 3D rendering, materials, loaders, animation and camera controls.

sources.title: React Three Fiber
sources.use: React renderer for Three.js scenes; already used by project. Optimize GLTF loading, draw calls and lazy mounting.

sources.title: Drei helpers
sources.use: Reusable R3F controls/helpers; select only relevant helpers.

sources.title: Babylon.js
sources.use: Alternative full 3D engine; do not add alongside Three/R3F unless a defined capability gap justifies it.

sources.title: VTK.js
sources.use: Scientific/volumetric 3D visualization; use if actual volumetric simulation fields exist.

sources.title: Plotly JavaScript
sources.use: Interactive scientific charts, heatmaps, contours, 3D plots; verify license and bundle impact.

sources.title: Apache ECharts
sources.use: Responsive dashboards and high-volume interactive charts; compare against existing Recharts.

sources.title: Motion for React accessibility
sources.use: Reduced-motion support and accessible animation transitions.

sources.title: GSAP ScrollTrigger
sources.use: Scroll-linked storytelling transitions; avoid motion overload and handle reduced-motion.

sources.title: MDN WebXR Device API
sources.use: Optional true headset VR only on supported secure contexts/hardware; normal 3D mission browser experience must remain primary.

sources.title: VRM humanoid avatar expressions specification
sources.use: Avatar format including humanoid rig, expressions, gaze and mouth/lip-sync controls.

sources.title: three-vrm
sources.use: Load/control VRM avatar in Three.js; animate expression and rig states.

sources.title: OpenAI Text-to-Speech guide
sources.use: Text-to-speech streaming and voice generation. Current docs indicate legacy TTS model shutdown on 2027-01-06; implement provider abstraction and re-check model support at build time. Disclose AI-generated voice.

sources.title: ElevenLabs streaming TTS
sources.use: Streaming text-to-speech alternative; verify commercial license, pricing, consent and privacy.

sources.title: 2025 Space Apps official global winners
sources.use: SpaceGenes+ won Best Use of Science; Resonant Exoplanets won Best Use of Data. Study integrated knowledge exploration and automated large-data analysis.

sources.title: 2024 Space Apps official global winners
sources.use: 2024 Best Use of Science was WMPGang (SkyShield: Orrery); Best Use of Data was GaamaRamma (Waterwise). Do not repeat older notes that conflate team/project titles.

sources.title: 2023 Space Apps official global winners
sources.use: LunarTech Ensemble won Best Use of Science; Storm Prophet won Best Use of Data. Study immersive scientific visualization and time-series modelling.

sources.title: 2025 Space Apps award definitions
sources.use: Official definitions: Best Use of Science = most valid use of science/scientific method; Best Use of Data = most effective accessibility/unique application of space data.
